name: Calaveras Square
summary: Calaveras Square is a community shopping center on Stockton's east side, anchored by Walmart and serving local residents with convenient access to everyday shopping needs. With a 4.1-star rating from over 2,200 reviews, the center offers value-oriented retail options and extended operating hours from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily.
demographics: Calaveras Square serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in Stockton's east side, attracting families and working professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area draws primarily from households with moderate income levels seeking convenient access to everyday shopping needs and value-oriented retailers. Typical visitors include budget-conscious shoppers, families with children looking for affordable goods, and local residents who prioritize convenience and competitive pricing in their shopping patterns.
description: Calaveras Square is a community shopping center located at 1019 East March Lane in Stockton, California, serving as a convenient retail destination for the city's east side residents. The center maintains a solid reputation with a 4.1-star rating from over 2,200 customer reviews, reflecting its role as a reliable neighborhood shopping hub. Operating daily from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Calaveras Square provides extended hours to accommodate shoppers throughout the day. The center features Walmart as a major anchor tenant, offering customers access to affordable everyday essentials, groceries, and general merchandise. Customer feedback highlights the center's value pricing and treasure-hunt shopping experience, though some reviews note that parking lot maintenance could be improved, indicating an active, well-trafficked shopping environment that serves the practical needs of Stockton's diverse community.
